title: cosmology-sims: running-vacuum background, likelihoods and mock tests
description: Code and results for the paper 'Can a running vacuum explain DESI's phantom crossing?' (Elijah Cavan, 2026): a Rust background solver for running-vacuum cosmologies, Python likelihoods and mock tests for DESI DR2 BAO, supernovae and the CMB, a CLASS v3.4.1 patch for the full Planck likelihood, the final MCMC chains, and Lean 4 proofs of the analytic results.
